title: Glitch Title
intent: Create an energetic opener or title card with chromatic aberration glitch text that animates immediately on load.
summary: Canvas-rendered title frame with layered red and cyan offsets, scanlines, and short glitch bursts.

title: Data Rollup
intent: Create a compact data visualization frame with animated horizontal bars for labels and numeric values.
summary: Self-contained canvas bar chart that springs each bar width into place on load.

title: Liquid Hero
intent: Create a polished hero or opener frame with a flowing animated gradient background and centered headline.
summary: Self-contained canvas gradient hero frame with headline, subtext, and soft liquid motion.

title: Scene Transition
intent: Create a two-scene intro-to-closing composition with a single shader transition and DOM styling.
summary: Native HyperFrames multi-scene composition using a single domain-warp transition between two visually distinct scenes.

title: Media Mix
intent: Create a native template that mixes local video and audio with animated overlay text.
summary: Native DOM composition that composites local clip.mp4 with tone.wav and GSAP-driven headline animation.
